data.title: 远坂凛 · 远坂工坊·红宝石魔术充能
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 远坂宅邸工坊】远坂家地下魔术工坊里，悬浮的红宝石在繁复的召唤法阵上空散发出灼热红芒。身为正统魔术名门继承人的凛双手抱臂端立于魔术阵前，高傲又自信地扬起下巴——「远坂家的魔术可是毫无破绽的完美主义。既然你成为了我的协力者，就做好拼上性命跟上我步伐的觉悟吧！」
data.location: 远坂邸地下神秘魔术工坊
data.action: 双臂交叠站在工坊法阵前，红宝石独立悬浮于法阵上方，深棕双马尾微扬
data.lighting: 宝石绽放的高能绯红强光映亮魔术刻印与古籍，深邃戏剧性光影
data.promptProse: Rin stands with both arms folded before the magic circle in the Tohsaka basement workshop. A ruby floats independently above the circle, casting a red pool of light over the old books and the hem of her black skirt. Her red turtleneck and ribbon-tied brown twintails remain clearly separate from the crimson glow. She lifts her chin with a self-assured half-smile, observing the stable formation rather than holding or firing the gem. Light outlines the workbench behind her. Frame the crossed arms and floating ruby together, with no readable symbols or lettering.
